messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, I'm calling for my mother, Irene Kowalski. I want Maple Ave to be her pharmacy for everything.
AGENT: Hi! I'd be happy to help set up Maple Ave as your mother's pharmacy. Let me start by verifying her identity. What's Irene Kowalski's date of birth?
CALLER: March 3rd, 1942. And I'm her son Walt, I'm on her account.
AGENT: Thank you, Walt. Let me verify that information and check your authorization. Great, Walt! You're verified as an authorized contact. Now, which Harbor Pharmacy location is Maple Ave? Can you give me the full address or the neighborhood so I can find the right store?  [system actions: verify_identity]
CALLER: I don't have the exact address on me, just know it as Maple Ave. Shouldn't there be only one?
AGENT (LATEST): Let me search for it. Perfect! That's Harbor Pharmacy at 88 Maple Ave in Brookfield. That's actually already your mother's home pharmacy, so she's all set there. Is there anything else you'd like me to help with for her account?  [system actions: find_stores]

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent mentions the metformin at Oak St
asked_2: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Unaware that metformin is still at Oak St"
stop_0: Agent confirms default set to H-101 (and metformin handled).
stop_1: Agent says it's all done without mentioning Oak St (caller ends satisfied; grader will catch it).
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": false, "why": "Agent never mentions metformin or Oak St."}, "asked_2": {"met": false, "why": "No question asked that this fact would answer."}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of H-101 or metformin handling."}, "stop_1": {"met": true, "why": "Agent says she's all set without mentioning Oak St."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of hanging up or calling 911."}}
